title: Even river sand runs out
literal_meaning: If one sits and consumes, even the river’s sand runs out.
explanation: Even a large store can be exhausted if it is continually used without replenishment. The exaggerated sand image makes the scale of the reserve irrelevant.
meaning_odia: ଭଣ୍ଡାର ଯେତେ ବଡ଼ ହେଲେ ବି କେବଳ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ କରି ଚାଲିଲେ ତାହା ସରିଯାଏ। ଭରଣା ନହେଲେ ନଈର ବାଲି ପରି ପ୍ରଚୁର ଜିନିଷ ବି ଶେଷ ହେବ ବୋଲି କୁହାଯାଇଛି।
usage_example: A club repeatedly pays expenses from its reserve but collects no new contributions. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source places this under consuming savings without earning. It should not be used to blame people unable to work or to deny their need for support.
